author: Steve_G

title: Great tour!
text: Our family had a wonderful full day tour with Maria.  It was incredibly hot out and Maria was very conscious of making sure we were all comfortable and spent as much of the tour in the shade as possible.  She was filled with so much information but did not overwhelm us as sometimes that can happen.  She also gave us a 45 minutes break half way through the tour to rest which I thought was great.  She is so pleasant and personable.  Even our kids (21 and 24) found her to be very engaging.  I highly recommend this tour.
author: Jill_G

title: Maria Leria is Seville in a person
text: Maria is an excellent guide. She did a bespoke 2 full day tour of seville, day 1 all the sights tourist don't normally go to see and day 2 all the usual tourist sites. Maria is a perfect guide, she is organised, her English is perfect, she makes all the information interesting and tells the history in an interesting way.  She is considerate and excellent with answering questions, the tours were at a perfect pace and she was very patient while I was taking 1000s photos around the city. title: Our Kids Loved The Tour Too
text: We had such a wonderful time with Maria, having her guide us on a private tour of Sevilla .  She’s friendly, energetic,  and extremely knowledgeable.   I had reached out to Maria before booking, mentioning I was looking for a tour with our two children (8 and 5).
